title: Localize repeatScheduleLabel and make it plural-aware
description: Convert this plain function to @Composable so it can read string/plural resources instead of deriving display text from the English enum constant name. Preserves existing behavior exactly (including the pre-existing 'None' vs 'Once' inconsistency between the count<=1 NONE case and the RepeatIntervalSelector's NONE label) while fixing the underlying non-localizable interval.name-derived text and adding real plural support for the count>=2 case. Both call sites in TaskItem.kt already invoke this from within Composable Text(...) calls, so no caller changes are needed.
acceptance_criteria: count<=1 branch returns stringResource-backed text per interval: interval_daily/interval_weekly/interval_monthly for DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY, and repeat_label_none for NONE (preserving the prior 'None' text, not 'Once')
count>=2 branch returns pluralStringResource-backed text per interval via repeat_every_days/repeat_every_weeks/repeat_every_months, and falls back to interval_once for the defensive NONE case
Return type remains String; no other function in the file is modified
name: repeatScheduleLabel
